name: Stitch Dark Theme
format:
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');
body.nr-dashboard-theme, .nr-dashboard-theme md-content {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0c0618 0%, #1a0f2e 40%, #12081f 100%) !important;
  font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme md-content {
  margin-left: 260px;
  padding: 16px 20px 32px !important;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .nr-dashboard-theme md-content {
    margin-left: 0;
    padding-top: 56px !important;
  }
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardpanel {
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.22);
  background: rgba(30, 20, 55, 0.72);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
  color: #c4b5fd;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer {
  padding-top: 8px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-sidebar {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 260px;
  height: 100vh;
  z-index: 50;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1e1435 0%, #120a22 100%);
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.2);
  padding: 22px 18px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-sidebar {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    position: relative;
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 12px;
  }
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-sidebar__brand {
  font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: #94a3b8;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-sidebar__title {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #f8fafc;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-sidebar__ver {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #a78bfa;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-nav {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-nav li {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  cursor: default;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-nav li.is-active {
  background: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.18);
  color: #f5f3ff;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-sidebar__cta {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
  color: #e2e8f0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-sidebar__user {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #cbd5e1;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-sidebar__avatar {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f472b6, #fb923c);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-main-head {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-main-head__title {
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: #f8fafc;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-main-head__sub {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-tabs {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-tabs__pill {
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #94a3b8;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-tabs__pill--on {
  background: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.25);
  color: #ede9fe;
  border-color: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.4);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-tabs__icons {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-size: 16px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-top-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(254, 202, 202, 0.95), rgba(252, 165, 165, 0.9));
  color: #7f1d1d;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 13px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.25);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-top-banner--hidden {
  display: none;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-top-banner__ico {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.2);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 800;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-top-banner__link {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #991b1b;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-metrics-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .nr-dashboard-theme .st-metrics-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .nr-dashboard-theme .st-metrics-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-metric {
  background: rgba(25, 15, 45, 0.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.2);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  min-height: 108px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-metric-label {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: #a78bfa;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-metric-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-metric-body--temp {
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #34d399;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.6);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-dot--hot {
  background: #f87171;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.7);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-metric-main {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #f1f5f9;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-metric-big {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-metric-sub {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #94a3b8;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-badge--safe {
  background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2);
  color: #6ee7b7;
  border: 1px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.35);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-badge--danger {
  background: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.22);
  color: #fecaca;
  border: 1px solid rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.4);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-bar {
  width: 100%;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-bar > i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a78bfa, #f472b6);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-thr {
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 6px;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-thr-line {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #cbd5e1;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-thr-line b {
  color: #f5f3ff;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-hist {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-hist th {
  text-align: left;
  padding: 10px 8px;
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #a78bfa;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.25);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-hist td {
  padding: 10px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12);
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-badge--emg {
  background: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.25);
  color: #fecaca;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .st-badge--passive {
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
  color: #94a3b8;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .btn-primary button,
.nr-dashboard-theme .btn-danger button,
.nr-dashboard-theme .btn-neutral button {
  min-height: 44px;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  border: none !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .btn-primary button {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #a78bfa) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .btn-danger button {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ea580c, #fb923c) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .btn-neutral button {
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2) !important;
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35) !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .stitch-chart-card .nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
  color: #c4b5fd;
}
</style>
